wake_priority.1_westGate: 50TB archive — instant loamSpine permanence. LOW power (40W idle). HIGHEST storage ROI.
wake_priority.2_strandGate: 64 cores + dual-vendor GPU + 256GB ECC. THE HPC beast. HIGH power but HIGHEST compute ROI.
wake_priority.3_southGate_tower: 128GB + 3D V-Cache + RTX 4060. Good inference node. MEDIUM power.
wake_priority.4_biomeGate: 56GB HBM2 + Threadripper. ML TRAINING capable. HIGHEST VRAM ROI but HIGH power.
wake_priority.5_kinGate: Extra RTX 3070 + staging. LOW priority but easy win.
wake_priority.6_blueGate: 128GB Windows node. Needs new IP, unclear location.
wake_priority.7_Jupiter_2: RISC-V! New ISA! 60 TOPS! Connect to backbone.
wake_priority.8_Pi_500s: 3× always-on ARM64 gossip nodes. Lowest friction to deploy.

special_assets_not_in_senses.3x_Akida_AKD1000: Neuromorphic NPUs — only 1 of 3 online (eastGate). strandGate + biomeGate have the other 2.
special_assets_not_in_senses.4x_SoloKey: FIDO2 hardware roots of trust. Only eastGate + ironGate using them.
special_assets_not_in_senses.Tesla_K80: 24GB GDDR5 dual-GPU — legacy but 24GB VRAM for large model inference.
special_assets_not_in_senses.2x_Titan_V: 1:2 NATIVE FP64! Only cards where native f64 > df64. 6.9 TFLOPS f64 EACH. IRREPLACEABLE for scientific compute.
special_assets_not_in_senses.2x_MI50: 1:4 native FP64, 16GB HBM2 each. SOVEREIGN AMD path. No CUDA dependency.
special_assets_not_in_senses.RX_6950_XT: 1:16 f64, 16GB. The ONLY dual-vendor GPU gate (strandGate).
special_assets_not_in_senses.3x_Intel_NUC: NUC6CAY — Celeron J3455. Tiny relay nodes. Currently unused.
special_assets_not_in_senses.Steam_Controllers_x2: TMR trackpads, gyro, haptics. GAIA'S HANDS.
special_assets_not_in_senses.Steam_Link: HDMI relay to any TV. Gaia's viewport.
